جَدْلٌ Hard, and strong; as also ↓ جَدِلٌ . (K, * TA.) ―
-b2- Also, and ↓ جِدْلٌ , A strong, firm, or compact, penis. (K, * TA.) ―
-b3- Also, (K,) or the former, (S, TA,) Any member, or limb: (S, K:) pl. جُدُولٌ. (S, TA.) ―
-b4- Also, (K,) or the former, (TA,) Any complete bone, [app. with its flesh,] not broken, nor mixed with aught beside: pl. [of pauc.] أَجْدَالٌ and [of mult.] جُدُولٌ. (K, TA.) ―
-b5- Also, (K,) or [the pl.] جُدُولٌ , (Lth, TA,) The bones of the arms and legs (Lth, K, TA) of a man: (Lth, TA:) and of the fore and hind legs of the victim termed عَقِيقَة. (TA from a trad.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
